tool_args.rationale: The bridge-supply and flux-conservation signatures support a temporal two-hop mechanism, but the short fixed-condition sweep cannot distinguish it from alternatives. An open-branch probe targets that ambiguity at lower cost than a fine trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary only u_now at fixed u_past, x_now, mem_conv, s_grad, and H, so they do not identify the two-hop bridge dynamics versus a static nonlinear response.
More points along the same setting are less discriminating than an open-branch perturbation.
It is explicitly nuisance/high-variance and does not resolve the temporal mechanism ambiguity.
